backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the backend canister with types for Question, UserProfile, SubscriptionPlan, and BillingCycle; exposes admin-gated question/plan management, user profile CRUD, and attempt recording, all protected by role-based access control via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two accessibility/contrast improvement features (REQ-52 and REQ-53) to their affected files, listing updates to global CSS color palette and text contrast fixes across multiple screen components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and recent changes of hooks, pages, styles, and config files in the React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, primary, destructive, chart, and sidebar color variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React SPA, configuring PWA manifest, iOS meta tags, theme color, a service worker registration script, and mounting the app at the `#root` div.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for the AIAPGET Unani PYQ Practice app, specifying name, icons, display mode, orientation, theme/background colors, and app categories.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing a caching strategy that uses network-only for ICP canister/API calls, cache-first for static assets, and network-first with offline fallback to cached index.html for HTML navigation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing screen navigation state across all app screens (home, quiz, results, review, topics, history, admin, subscription, payment), conditionally rendering the persistent AppHeader and wrapping the app in QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders a sticky app header with a kebab menu (three-dot) that opens a dropdown navigation drawer linking to all major screens like Home, Topics, History, Subscription, and Admin.
frontend/src/data/questions.ts: Defines the Question interface, topic/year constants, and a static array of Unani medicine multiple-choice questions with explanations used throughout the quiz app.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching admin questions, adding new questions to the backend, and merging backend questions with static local questions while deduplicating by text.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing quiz attempt history stored in localStorage, including reading, recording new attempts, and clearing history.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionQuerie: React Query hook that fetches subscription plans from the ICP backend actor, returning an empty array if the actor is unavailable.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines a warm parchment-themed CSS variable palette for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelScreen.tsx: Password-protected admin panel screen that allows adding new quiz questions via a form and listing existing questions, using React Query mutations and queries.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryScreen.tsx: Displays the user's past quiz attempts with summary stats (attempts, average score, best score) and a list of individual results, with an option to clear history.
frontend/src/pages/HomeScreen.tsx: Home screen showing a hero banner, stats row, and navigation cards for starting a quiz, browsing by topic/year, viewing history, subscription plans, and the admin panel.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentMethodSelector: Payment method selection screen supporting UPI, credit/debit card, net banking, and wallets with mock payment processing and a success confirmation view.
frontend/src/pages/QuizScreen.tsx: Interactive quiz screen that presents one question at a time with a 60-second countdown timer, tracks answers, supports skipping, and calls onComplete when the quiz finishes.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsScreen.tsx: Displays quiz results including score percentage, performance tier, correct/incorrect/skipped counts, time taken, and a topic breakdown, while recording the attempt via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/ReviewScreen.tsx: Shows a paginated answer review screen where users can navigate through each quiz question and see their answer highlighted against the correct answer with pass/fail indicators.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPlansScre: Renders monthly and yearly subscription plan cards with feature lists and a toggle selector, navigating to a payment screen when the user chooses a plan.
frontend/src/pages/TopicBrowserScreen.ts: Provides a browsable list of quiz questions organized by topic or year, fetched from the backend, with expandable sections and a button to start a shuffled quiz for each group.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, using sessionStorage for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, accordion animations, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the state of an AIAPGET Unani MCQ practice app at version 47, including architectural notes, known issues (admin panel bugs, persistence failures), and a list of existing and planned features.
